subject.title: Feature request: config option to disable restart sentinel notification

question: Should OpenClaw add a public restart-sentinel notification suppression contract, and should it be global config, per-request protocol state, or both?
rationale: The remaining issue is real, but AGENTS.md and VISION.md make new config/protocol surface a high-bar product/API choice rather than an automatic repair.

options.title: Add narrow outbound-notice suppression
options.body: Gate only the direct restart-sentinel channel notice while preserving wake, heartbeat, system events, continuation delivery, and route recovery.

options.title: Keep current visible sentinel behavior
options.body: Preserve restart visibility as the product contract and close suppression requests after documenting why operator noise is accepted.

options.title: Use per-request quiet mode only
options.body: Avoid a persistent config knob and let control-plane callers request quiet restarts when they own another confirmation path.

recommendation.title: Add narrow outbound-notice suppression
recommendation.body: Gate only the direct restart-sentinel channel notice while preserving wake, heartbeat, system events, continuation delivery, and route recovery.

likelyOwner.reason: The original gateway config/update restart flow is tied to steipete, making this the strongest available owner for choosing the public config/protocol shape.
